about: The league view of v1 L-06: the simulated league (frozen draw, seed 20261030) under the teaching posterior (prior mean 0), thirty 90% or 95% posterior intervals, a chosen pair and the tally of the 435 pairs. Ported from v1's four league cases (league-overlap, league-wide, league-pick95, league-reversed), with the touch-view keys dropped from the queries (mode, gap: the touch view is app 1.11), prior_sd renamed priorSd (a preset key is one plain word), the caption in its v3 wording, and v1's registry keys and base-R oracle rows as sources. New in v3: the apart row's bound at three decimals (.950 and .975), the tally's line on the highest probability among overlapping pairs, the note's seed and prior SD, the chosen-row marking, the key's third item (which follows the pair), an apart pair as probable as the overlapping pick (U06 and U20, from the oracle direction matrix), prior SD .05 (oracle tally and posterior rows), a nested pair, and the pick following the level. The overlap amounts have no independent source in these files: the general rules read their displays back.
